correctness.rationale: Exact branch decomposition and reciprocal-symmetry identity have been derived without approximation. Strict log-concavity makes the translation kernel TP2; LR order is proved by induction, and antisymmetric integration gives each nearest-neighbor inequality. The mirrored boundary and parity cases follow from reversing even iid increments. Deterministic Gaussian cubature agrees in 36 tests; the theorem rests on analytic proof, not quadrature.

value.rationale: The known disorder-averaged U shape is a physical noise-diagnostic baseline but prior proofs/approximations cited only high-temperature expansion, low-temperature limiting behavior or numerical evaluation. Exact strict monotonicity uniformly across all positive temperature and chain lengths rules out an intermediate inversion and underpins that baseline without numerical parameter sweeps; extension to log-concave non-Gaussian disorder identifies a physically relevant robustness class.
